Name: Deadduch's Sam the Aussie Cattle Dog Mix (for CP)
Author: Shreedle
Description:
Fully compatible with SDV 1.6+. Granted, this is a pretty simple mod.

Back when XNB mods were prevalent, this was one of my favorites for the dog. Coming back years later, I did not find a Content Patcher version. However, the author stated that anyone is free to take the XNB mod and update it, so I decided to make it as my first ever mod back in 2022.

This mod completely edits the visuals of the pet dog and the icon in Marnie's shop menu. By default, the mod selects the first vanilla dog, but you can configure it to any of the five vanilla dog types.

Deadduch's original mod is here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/351]Custom Dog Skin - Sam the Aussie Cattle Mix[/url]

Will be taken down if the original author changes their mind and no longer wants it up.

[b][u]To install manually:[/u][/b]
1) Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
4) Download this mod and unzip into your Mods folder.
